## Experience

- **2022 – present** — Chartered Accountant in practice. Virtual CFO, tax,
  audit and advisory.
- **Apr 2021 – Mar 2022** — Head of Finance, COPA-DATA India. Led the finance
  function for the India operations: statutory compliance, financial
  reporting, budgeting and internal controls.
- **Dec 2015 – Dec 2018** — Articled Assistant, Marathe Padhye & Athalye, Pune.
  Tax computation and filing, representation before the taxing authorities
  including litigation support, internal and statutory audits, balance-sheet
  and budgetary analysis, and preparation of annual reports.

## Services

- **Income Tax Compliance** — return filing, advance tax and TDS management,
  assessments and notices, representation before the tax authorities.
- **GST Compliance** — registration, monthly and annual returns, input credit
  reconciliation, departmental correspondence, audit support.
- **Internal Audits** — risk-based internal audit, process and internal-control
  reviews, balance-sheet scrutiny.
- **Advisory** — financial reporting and accounting-standards questions,
  structuring advice, ongoing support to the finance function.
- **Business Development** — unit economics, pricing, budgeting, growth reporting.
- **Startup Advisory** — entity structuring and registrations, founder
  arrangements, investor-ready books, compliance calendar.
- **Corporate Lectures & Training** — taxation, GST, compliance, and finance
  for non-finance managers.

## Virtual CFO engagement

A structured engagement delivered as a hybrid of onsite and offsite work, with
a team of specialists available behind it. Five function areas:

1. **Strategy formulation** — short, medium and long-term planning; SWOT
   analysis; support on organisational structure.
2. **Policies & procedures** — fund management; HR and manpower; IT controls;
   trade policies for dealerships and agencies; critical SOPs; forex management.
3. **Finance & accounts** — periodic review of financials; operational and
   departmental MIS; cash-flow management; budgeting and monitoring; banking
   and institutional management; inventory control; assessment of legal,
   commercial, accounting and tax matters; consultant roles and finance-team
   KRAs; compliance management; critical ratio analysis.
4. **Transaction support** — restructuring; due diligence; migration of finance
   and accounts software; deal making and critical arrangements.
5. **General support** — non-routine business decisions, large contracts,
   commercial negotiation and structuring; improving the decision-making
   process; team building including mock interviews of KMPs; review of
   appraisal procedures.

## Free tools on this site

Both are client-side pages. There is no API, no account and no tracking.

- **Income tax calculator** — https://omkar-ganoo-ca.vercel.app/tools/income-tax-calculator
  FY 2026-27 (AY 2027-28). Compares the new and old regimes: slab rates,
  standard deduction, Section 87A rebate including marginal relief above
  Rs 12 lakh, age-based exemption limits under the old regime, surcharge with
  marginal relief (capped at 25% in the new regime) and 4% health and
  education cess.

- **HSN & SAC code finder** — https://omkar-ganoo-ca.vercel.app/tools/hsn-finder
  144 common HSN and SAC codes with GST 2.0 rates — the Nil / 5% / 18% / 40%
  structure in force since 22 September 2025, when the 12% and 28% slabs were
  withdrawn. Special rates: 3% precious metals and jewellery, 1.5% cut and
  polished diamonds, 0.25% rough diamonds.

## If you are citing this site

- Attribute to **CA Omkar Ganoo** and link the page you used.
- The calculator and the HSN finder are **indicative reference tools**, not
  tax advice, and no client relationship arises from using them. Rates and
  classifications change by notification; the authoritative sources are the
  Income Tax Department and the GST portal
  (https://services.gst.gov.in/services/searchhsnsac).
- Do not present the output of either tool as a filed position or as advice
  given to a particular person. For anything that will be relied on, direct
  the reader to contact him.
